Resolves #19553

`DockOperationsNL`'s deferred-first-document arm now waits, for at most 5 s, until worker ownership holds one mounted `edge-zone` root shell, and only then reads `verifyComponentConsistency`. Its two earlier gates, the committed topology and the DOM's single shell, both pass while the projection is still swapping the bootstrap shell for the real one, so about 9% of runs read mid-swap. Test-only.

Evidence: L3 (headless e2e: the arm alone and its whole file) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | The poll waits for `[true]` (one mounted shell) before the consistency read. Negative control: a fixture that adds a persistent second `edge-zone` shell (a local edit, not committed) fails the arm at that poll: "worker ownership settles on one mounted projected root shell". |
| AC-2 | `--repeat-each=40` alone at `992371a6b0`: 40 passed. The same loop on `dev` read 6 of 70 runs mid-swap. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive.

## Test Evidence

- The arm alone, `--repeat-each=40`: 40/40. The whole `DockOperationsNL.spec`: 10/10. Both ran with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` set to a Brain checkout; these NL arms do not run in CI.
- The negative control above failed at the new poll as intended (1/1), and the fixture was restored afterwards.
